title: Async Resources
description: Microsoft.UI.Reactor (Reactor)'s async hooks — UseResource, UseInfiniteResource, and UseMutation — replace the "one UseState for data, one for loading, one for error, one UseEffect to tie them together" pattern. They own the fetch lifecycle: cancellation on deps-change, drop late results after unmount, shared caching across siblings, and stale-while-revalidate by default.
